DEVICE_SHARES.description: KV namespace used to store short-lived Harbor device handoff records.

APP_METADATA.description: KV namespace for published download metadata such as the latest public Harbor build URL and version.

APP_NAME.description: Public name shown on the share pages. The default is Harbor.

CARGO_URL_SCHEME.description: Custom URL scheme for the desktop app deep link. Keep cargo-syncthing unless you changed the app.

DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional fallback public download URL for Harbor when the APP_METADATA KV key latest-download has not been set yet.

DOWNLOAD_VERSION.description: Optional fallback version label shown next to the download button.

DOWNLOAD_BUILD_LABEL.description: Optional fallback build label or channel text shown next to the download button.
